page.overview:
What is Fuchsia City?

Fuchsia City is a city located in the southwestern part of Kanto. The Safari Zone is here with a zoo located close by. The Area's gym specializes in -type Pokémon. Koga is the gym leader in Fuchsia City in the Kanto games; the Johto games see his daughter Janine take over the gym. In FireRed and LeafGreen, the move deleter is also present here.

A Move Deleter is present in a house of Fuchsia City. The Move Deleter can make any move forget of any Pokémon with no cost; he can also help the Pokémon forget the HM moves too. In Generation I, II and IV, the Move Deleter isn't present.

The Fuchsia Gym is a Poison-type Pokémon gym. Koga is the gym leader in Generation I and III. Whereas, the Gym leader in Generation II and IV is Koga's daughter Janine. Trainers who are victorious at this gym receive Soul Badge.
